title: Commits, Diff & History Inspection
description: Record immutable snapshots with git commit, compare changes with git diff, and navigate history using git log and git show.

blocks.content: A feature works today. You need a named checkpoint you can inspect and return to later. What is the smallest Git action that keeps the work safe?

A commit is a saved checkpoint with a message. `git commit -m "describe the change"` saves the staged changes; `git log` shows those checkpoints.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["Working files"] -->|"choose an action"| B["Git history"] -->|"share or recover"| C["Team project"]
```

blocks.question: What does a commit save?
blocks.explanation: A commit records the state you staged along with its message.

blocks.prompt: Model the Git idea in a tiny simulator. Export a function named `commitFile` that takes `(working, staged, file)` and returns a new staged list containing `file` once. Do not change either input list.

tests.description: works when no working files are listed yet
keeps an already staged file while adding another
